representations.table: Exact values, full metric sets, rankings and operational drill-down.
representations.trend: Time-series movement: daily/weekly/monthly trends, pacing, selected-entity history.
representations.barsVertical: Small number of discrete categories or side-by-side comparisons such as Android vs iOS.
representations.barsHorizontal: Rankings with many named categories: campaigns, products, keywords, locations, search terms.
representations.heatmap: Two-dimensional comparison where rows and columns are entities/dimensions and cell intensity makes outliers easy to spot.

legend.gridPrinciple: Use grids for Campaign × Placement, Product × Campaign, Keyword × KPI, Creative × KPI, or Campaign × Device rather than forcing every dimension into a chart.
legend.metricNormalization: Keep native metric names per platform; map them to common semantic categories (spend, volume, efficiency, outcome) rather than renaming.
legend.noAlerts: Dashboards are for reporting only. Alert automations live elsewhere.
legend.keys:
metric.key / dimension.key are CANONICAL — they resolve through contracts/config/primitives.yaml metric_sources (basic repo) and are the ONLY values that appear in a card's query.task.metrics/dimensions. label is the platform-native display word and renders verbatim (never rename to force parity). source=gold reads gold_

_campaign_daily/account_daily; source=bronze grains (keyword/search-term/placement/product) read DM/bronze fact tables (grain rule).
